name: emberfield
description: Generative art with p5.js: an algorithmic philosophy first, then its expression as seeded, reproducible code in an interactive viewer with parameter exploration.
tagline: One seed, one field, forever repeatable.
highlights: Art begins as a written algorithmic philosophy; every parameter must trace back to one of its principles.
The seeding law makes every piece reproducible: the same seed renders the same pixels, verified headlessly.
The viewer ships seed navigation, parameter sliders, colour pickers and PNG export in one self-contained file.
A derivative of Anthropic's algorithmic-art under Apache-2.0, restyled and tested; provenance in NOTICE.md.
quickstart:
cd skills/ui-ux/emberfield && ./install.sh

# In Claude Code:
#   "Create generative art of slow rivers of light" — the skill answers with
#   a philosophy .md and a seeded .html artwork you can explore.
open examples/emberflow.html   # the worked example

permissions.filesystem: install.sh copies the skill into $EMBERFIELD_PREFIX/skills (default ~/.claude/skills); generated artworks are written wherever the agent is asked to put them
permissions.network: generated artworks load the pinned, integrity-hashed p5.js from its CDN when opened; the skill itself downloads nothing at install time
permissions.environment: EMBERFIELD_PREFIX is read by the install and uninstall wrappers

tests.coverage: 14 tests: the viewer's control contract, the seeding law, provenance (licence and notice), template syntax, and pixel-identical headless rendering of the same seed twice against a hash-pinned p5.js

security.reviewed_by: Ported and reviewed 2026-08-15: upstream code audited, trademarks removed, CDN reference pinned with subresource integrity, determinism proven by rendering.

verifications.by: Port review (Claude Opus 5, on the maintainer's machine)
verifications.method: Audited the upstream skill, rebuilt the viewer without upstream branding, pinned p5.js by SRI and SHA-256, and verified the seeding promise by rendering seed 12345 twice headlessly (identical hashes) and seed 512144 once (different hash).
verifications.findings: Derivative of anthropics/skills algorithmic-art (Apache-2.0). Changes and non-claims are recorded in NOTICE.md.
